item.title: 'My Dad Saved for My Education Instead of Dowry; He Stood by Me & Changed My Life'
item.description: The town in Bihar where I grew up witnessed girls my age being married right after Class 10. It was customary for fathers to set aside money for their dowry. But, I had different dreams. And so my father invested that same money into my education. Things were not always easy as we lived in a kaccha (makeshift) house. item.description: The Miyazaki mango, one of the most expensive fruits in the world, is renowned for its distinct taste, smooth texture, and rich aroma.
